## HEADNOTE
Sample Tenancy Act, 2001, Section 7 as amended in 2012 - security deposit cap raised to three months' rent - applies only to tenancies created on or after 1 July 2012.
## FACTS
A tenancy created in 2010 carried a deposit of three months' rent. The tenant relied on the pre-amendment cap of two months.
## ARGUMENTS
The landlord argued that the 2012 amendment permitted three months' rent and applied to all subsisting tenancies. The tenant argued the amendment was prospective.
## REASONING
The amendment substituted Section 7 with effect from 1 July 2012 and contains no provision applying it to existing tenancies. Substantive limits on contractual terms operate prospectively unless the statute says otherwise.
## HOLDING
For tenancies created before 1 July 2012 the two month cap continues to apply. The three month cap governs tenancies created on or after that date.
